translation_notes: RDFS.comment -> rdfs:comment, and each graph.add((s, p, o)) -> 'self.graph += g{ {self.identifier} rdfs:comment {comment} }'; the two adds sit in different branches, so nothing is merged
only the prefix actually used is declared; the draft also declared rdf: (unused in this region) merely because RDF is in the import list
the draft inserted the @prefix statements after the imports; moved above them so the declaration precedes every use (block scope is lexical)

'self.graph += g{...}' rebinds the attribute (Graph.__iadd__ returns self), where the original called self.graph.add(...) in place; observationally identical for any object with a plain 'graph' attribute, which is what infixowl's Individual has
original.py runs as extracted: the region's whole context is rdflib.term.Identifier plus the RDFS namespace, both already imported
